en.title: Stock Trading with Algo Override
en.description:
Given daily stock prices prices[i] and an action array algo[i] (0 means buy, 1 means sell), the original profit is the sum of sell prices minus the sum of buy prices. You may choose one contiguous range of length exactly k and set every algo in it to 1. Find the maximum total profit achievable after the change. Assume you hold enough shares, so selling is not limited by inventory.

The I/O protocol and the explicitly marked site-supplemented constraints were prepared by CSWork.
en.input: The first line contains n, k; the second line contains n positive integers prices[i]; the third line contains n 0/1 values algo[i]. This site adds 1≤k≤n≤200000, 1≤prices[i]≤10^9.
en.output: Output the maximum total profit (a signed 64-bit integer).
en.explanation: See the accompanying solution for the full approach and proof.
hints: First turn the original problem's rules into exact input and output, then compute step by step according to the rules.
